class.name: GamepadContext
class.brief_description: A named layer of gamepad bindings in [InputRouter]'s context path.
class.description: A gamepad context groups the bindings that apply while one part of the game has focus: a seat, a menu, a vehicle. [InputRouter] keeps a path of contexts, outer to inner: base contexts set with [method InputRouter.set_gamepad_base_contexts], then contexts pushed with [method InputRouter.push_gamepad_context]. For each pad input, the router walks the path from the innermost context outward. The first context with an ungated binding for that input wins its plain press; ungated bindings below are not reached. Gated bindings (chords, see [member RouteBindingResource.gate]) are collected from every context the walk passes, inner first, and win while their gate is held: a modifier is a layer over the whole path, and anything the layer does not bind falls through. A context with no binding for the input decides by [member fallback]. A [member modal] context, or one whose [member fallback] is not [constant FALLBACK_INHERIT], stops the walk, so gated bindings below it are not reached either. If the walk reaches the bottom of the path, the raw pad event passes to Godot, except for a button some reachable binding uses as a gate, which the router keeps. Contexts are identified by [member id]. The router knows a context once a binding, map or path names it; register the resource with [method InputRouter.register_gamepad_context] to apply its [member fallback] and [member modal] settings. An id used before registration inherits and is not modal.

members.member: What happens to an input this context has no binding for.
The name the router, maps and bindings refer to this context by. Must be unique in the project.
A display name for tools and prompts. The router does not read it.

If [code]true[/code], contexts below this one in the path never see pad input. An input this context does not bind follows [member fallback], with [constant FALLBACK_INHERIT] treated as [constant FALLBACK_SWALLOW].

constants.constant: Ask the context below. At the bottom of the path the raw event passes to Godot.
Consume the input. Neither lower contexts nor Godot see it.
Pass the raw pad event to Godot, so GUI focus, [code]ui_*[/code] actions and the [InputMap] see it.
